name: first-parents
description:
The first item of a list that is a parent of the phrase, or an empty cell when none is.

parents: the phrases that may be parents, in the order to try; a parent is a phrase whose words all stand in the phrase. Empty items are skipped.

Example: semkit read --text "купить диван" --text "угловой диван" first-parents "диван,купить диван" write -
-> купить диван, диван; угловой диван, диван

The step writes its result to a new column <column>_parent.

options.name: --parents
options.description: the phrases that may be parents, in the order to try; a parent is a phrase whose words all stand in the phrase. Empty items are skipped. Items: a comma list 'a,b', @FILE (one item per line, or the first column of a table) or @NAME of a list.

options.name: --as
options.description: Write the result to a new column NAME and keep the working column as it is.

arguments.name: PARENTS
arguments.description: the phrases that may be parents, in the order to try; a parent is a phrase whose words all stand in the phrase. Empty items are skipped. Items: a comma list 'a,b', @FILE (one item per line, or the first column of a table) or @NAME of a list. The same as --parents PARENTS.
